Expectations for hand-off notes in detail
This section describes why careful work counts
Hand-off Notes for Animal Travel Service

The purpose of this section is to set clear expectations for hand-off notes so every traveler receives steady, humane, and accurate support. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk relies on notes that are complete, calm, and easy to follow. Write in plain language and record only facts that another colleague can use without guessing. Include the animal's condition, the traveler's concerns, and any handling step already approved, while avoiding emotional language that could blur the record.

Use a warm professional tone when speaking with travelers and when writing notes for the next colleague. If a passenger is worried, listen carefully, acknowledge the concern, and summarize the issue in a way that supports the next action. The desk should never rush a hand-off when important details are missing. If something is uncertain, state what has been checked and what still needs review. For bird travel, <<FACT F077>> Keep the note brief, direct, and useful to the person taking over.

When a health document is part of the file, confirm that the record is present and readable before the hand-off is closed. For rabbit travel, <<FACT F082>> Note whether the document has been reviewed, whether any follow-up is needed, and whether the traveler was informed of the next step. Use calm, humane methods around each animal, and avoid wording that sounds stern or dismissive. The goal is to help the next teammate continue service smoothly and safely.

If a matter must be moved to a senior colleague, state the reason clearly and route it through <<FACT F106>> before ending your note. Keep the sequence easy to trace, and do not leave out any step that could affect the animal or the traveler. Good hand-off notes protect trust, reduce avoidable delays, and help the desk stay consistent across shifts.

Contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor for any case that feels unclear or needs immediate review.
